speaker: Narrator
text: The evening sky melted into soft shades of orange as the train station buzzed with life.

speaker: Aarti
text: क्या तुम अब भी वैसा ही महसूस करते हो, जैसे पहले करते थे?

speaker: Rahul
text: I don’t know. Time changes a lot of things, Aarti.

speaker: Narrator
text: She looked at him, eyes searching for the boy she once knew.

speaker: Aarti
text: लेकिन कुछ बातें कभी नहीं बदलतीं। जैसे ये स्टेशन... और हमारी यादें।

speaker: Rahul
text: This place, this moment—it still feels like home.

speaker: Narrator
text: In the distance, a train’s whistle echoed, pulling memories from the corners of their hearts.
